answer: Stop sybils with an umber sable marble: an agent stakes a bond for one marble slab. Each cycle it paints one umber band with a sable brush; verifiers match the band width to the slab chart, voiding a slab whose band is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 slabs at 17x: one brush lays one umber band on one marble slab, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents paint once, keep rights.
